sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Turn gear, creatures, and consumables into quick hooks for investigation and payoff.

sections.title: GM notes
items: Bespoke gear can remain rare; most of it is a story clue before it is a reward.
Hybrid animals should show motive and habitat, not just attacks.
Use Sable Sap or Bugbane Berry when the table needs relief that still feels local.
